text:
maria: Quick status check — kernel + continuous-batching + KV sprint. Short bullets: canary latency down ~12% overall, but p99 spikes for long sequences (>1024). Owners: kernel=devin, kv-cache=jia. Blockers: cache eviction race + one CI flake failing kernel microbatch test. Asking for quick triage and PR review pings.

devin: Saw the p99 traces, digging. My hypothesis is microbatch scheduling hitting the slow path when seq_len > 1k, adding extra kernel sync.

jia: Cache eviction race reproduced locally, working on a fix. Impact: under heavy concurrency we sometimes drop prefixes causing KV misses. Patch coming in a minute — needs one reviewer.

sam: I can review the cache PR — ping me @jia when it's up. Also noticed the canary shows higher var latency for the third shard.

devin: @sam thanks. For kernel microbatch test: repro steps in case helpful:
```bash
# repro loop (local)
python tests/microbatch/repro_long_seq.py --model rhn-small --seq-len 1200 --batch 16
# watch nvprof logs
nvprof --print-gpu-trace --log-file nv.log python ...
```
Outputs show extra memcpy around attention kernel at iteration ~50.

leo: Ops note — canary deployed to us-west-2 at 11:05 via deploy-bot. Metrics: tokens/sec +8%, avg latency -10%, but p99 +6% on long requests. ops-bot: Canary canary-237 deployed (us-west-2).

maria: Thanks @leo. Plan proposal: 1) Jia lands eviction fix + one reviewer (target EOD). 2) Devin will gate a kernel micro-optim quickpatch and add unit that exercises long sequence path. 3) Sam to review cache PR and kernel perf PR. 4) Roll canary back only if p99 continues rising after fixes.

jia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123 — eviction fix. Marked as draft until tests pass. CC @sam @devin

sam: Reviewing now. Quick note: test flake looks like unrelated CI flakiness in our runner — ticket #INF-721 filed.

devin: I pushed a branch with microkernel instrumentation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/compare/microbatch-instr. Adds timing around kernel queue and a guard to avoid the slow sync path. Needs perf runs.

maria: Can we get a quick canary with both patches (eviction fix + instrumentation guard) in a canary variant? I want metrics before full rollout.

leo: I can stage canary image with tags: runtime:canary-4123-instr. ETA 30m. Will wire up metric dashboard: /dashboards/runtime/canary-4123.

ops-bot: Canary image pushed: runtime:canary-4123-instr. New canary deployed to us-west-2/2 nodes.

devin: Perf runs started against canary. Early signal: p50/p95 improved, p99 still noisy but fewer spikes. Attaching two quick plots to the dashboard.

sam: Cache PR LGTM aside from tiny nit. @jia please address test name. Once green I can approve.

jia: Fixed test name, re-pushed. Tests passing locally, waiting CI.

maria: Good. Dependencies check — who owns rollout gating for Dedicated customers? We need to coordinate infra change if we adjust batch window.

leo: Dedicated rollout gating: infra-platform owns config flag. I'll open an infra PR to expose batch_window override per-tenant. CC infra-platform.

maria: Ok. Final ask: can owners paste short checklists here once tasks done: 
- eviction fix merged/PR #
- kernel guard merged/PR #
- canary metric link + verdict
- infra flag PR # (if needed)

devin: I'll post kernel PR when ready. Expect ~2 hours.

sam: I'll approve cache PR asap after CI.

jia: eviction PR #4123 merged.

ops-bot: Deployment note: canary-4123-instr running 2/2 healthy.

leo: Dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/runtime/canary-4123. Early verdict: acceptable to continue canary for 6 hours.

maria: Great, thanks everyone. If p99 stabilizes we schedule full rollout tomorrow AM. Otherwise we escalate to oncall. Ping here for async updates. :rocket: 

devin: Will follow up with kernel PR and perf numbers.

sam: Marking as follow-up in my queue.

jia: Closing loop once CI + merge done.

ops-bot: Reminder: Oncall rotation starting in 2 hours — @maria oncall next.

maria: noted, thanks.
